newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end winning streak.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end winning streak.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks were slightly lower Monday as profit taking halted the market's six straight sessions of record closes.

Based on early and unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 9.95 points at 7,772.09. On the broader market, declining issues led advances by a small margin on moderate volume of 418 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
